title: HandoffRow
description: V3.6 shared queue row -- the flattened, ChatGPT/Gmail-side-consumable view of one READY_TO_SEND lead. Keyed by lead_id (idempotent upsert, never appended). Split into two logical queues by preferred_channel (CONTACT_FORM -> CONTACT_FORM_READY queue, else -> EMAIL_READY queue) -- never mixed. Fields fall into two ownership groups: Lead-Engine-owned (recomputed fresh every sync, safe to overwrite) and external-owned (gmail_state, delivery_state, reply_state, follow_up_state, gmail_message_id, gmail_thread_id, suppression_reason once set externally -- Lead Engine's own sync never touches these after creation; only scripts/import_outreach_results.py does).

lead_id.description: == prospect_id, the stable idempotency key for this row

business_id.description: Normalized website domain when known, else same as lead_id -- lets the same real business be recognized across a future recycled lead_id

sub_niche.description: No sub-niche taxonomy exists in config/niches.yaml yet -- always null, never guessed

preferred_channel.description: NAMED_EMAIL/COMPANY_EMAIL -> EMAIL_READY queue; CONTACT_FORM -> CONTACT_FORM_READY queue, never mixed

lead_engine_state.description: Lead Engine's own pipeline status at last sync (e.g. SEND_WINDOW_PLANNED) -- NEVER equated with gmail_state/delivery_state

gmail_state.description: External-owned. Null until scripts/import_outreach_results.py records a real event. READY_TO_SEND/SEND_WINDOW_PLANNED lead_engine_state != GMAIL_SENT gmail_state.

delivery_state.description: External-owned. NO_BOUNCE_DETECTED != DELIVERED -- see OPERATING-RULES.md Sec.2.

gmail_message_id.description: External-owned, set only by an imported GMAIL_SENT event

gmail_thread_id.description: External-owned, set only by an imported GMAIL_SENT event

last_action.description: The most recent state-changing action from either side (a sync republish or an imported event type)

human_review.description: true once a HUMAN_HANDOFF event is imported, or the prospect itself carries a HUMAN_REVIEW status

suppression_reason.description: External-owned once set by an imported SUPPRESSED event or Lead Engine's own suppression registry at first export -- never silently cleared

created_at.description: First time this lead_id was exported -- preserved across every re-sync

updated_at.description: Last time Lead Engine's own fields were refreshed (every sync touches this even if nothing external changed)
